cases.name: no checkpoint
cases.why: The chain is consistent from genesis and completeness is not proven.

cases.name: checkpoint at the tip
cases.why: The checkpoint covers all three exported records.

cases.name: checkpoint in the middle
cases.why: The checkpoint covers only the first two records.

cases.name: checkpoint at count zero
cases.why: A zero-count checkpoint authenticates the genesis hash of an empty log.

cases.name: checkpoints across key rotation
cases.why: Both published keys verify and coverage uses the greatest count.

cases.name: altered record
cases.why: The second record has a changed target and its original hash.

cases.name: reordered records
cases.why: Swapping the two newest entries breaks the third record's previous link.

cases.name: missing middle record
cases.why: The third record still links to the omitted second record.

cases.name: truncated chain
cases.why: The export is a valid prefix, but the retained checkpoint requires its last record.

cases.name: malformed record
cases.why: The flagged field is a string instead of a boolean.

cases.name: unsupported checkpoint version
cases.why: The signature verifies and the signed version is 2.

cases.name: bad signature
cases.why: The signature has a changed byte and the original header and payload.

cases.name: policy-typed JWS
cases.why: A token signed with a known test key has the policy bundle type.

cases.name: unknown kid
cases.why: The header names a key absent from the checkpoint JWKS.

cases.name: workspace mismatch
cases.why: The signed workspace differs from the workspace of the records.

cases.name: checkpoint beyond the chain
cases.why: The checkpoint claims a fourth record and the export has three.

cases.name: contradicting checkpoints
cases.why: Both signatures verify and the two tips differ at the same count.

cases.name: filtered export
cases.why: The export starts at the second record, whose previous hash is not genesis.

cases.name: padded compact JWS
cases.why: The signature segment ends in a padding character.

cases.name: impossible issue date
cases.why: The signed date is February 30.

cases.name: issue date in year zero
cases.why: A checkpoint issue date cannot use year 0000.

cases.name: rewritten tip
cases.why: The chain verifies and reaches the signed count with a different hash.

cases.name: paged export
cases.why: The cursor is a string. The audit export requires null.

cases.name: out-of-range number in an unknown export field
cases.why: The export allows any value for this field, including an out-of-range number read as infinity.

cases.name: duplicate keys member in the JWKS
cases.why: The trusted JWKS repeats the keys member, even though its last value contains the signer.

cases.name: duplicate member inside JWKS metadata
cases.why: Member names are compared after decoding escapes, even inside ignored arrays and objects.

cases.name: JWKS members that differ in case
cases.why: The unrecognized uppercase KEYS member is distinct from keys.

description: OpenPlexer audit exports and checkpoints. The signing keys are public test keys only.
